transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve been feeling like I’m messing things up for everybody. Like I don’t really belong in my apprenticeship, and when I make mistakes, it feels like I let my family down, and the younger apprentices too. Other people would probably just fix it and move on, but I can’t seem to.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say most of the time. I’ve felt pretty down on myself, I guess, but “sad or empty” is harder to say.
Have you been enjoying things you usually like to do?
Not really. I mean… I used to draw a lot, play volleyball, keep up with this volunteer group. Lately I just kind of walk past my sketchbook or ignore the texts. It doesn’t really feel like much.
Do you often feel guilty about things you've done or not done?

Yeah… I do. Mostly about work and the apprenticeship. I keep feeling like I’ve ruined things for everyone, or like I’m kind of a fake there. Even small mistakes feel like I’m letting my family down, and the younger apprentices too… even if other people would probably just fix it and move on.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?
I guess sometimes, yeah. Not all the time. I haven’t really been keeping track of it.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
I don’t think so. I haven’t really been checking, but my clothes seem about the same.
Do you often feel like you're not good enough?

Yeah… I do. That’s kind of why I came in. I keep feeling like I’ve ruined things for everybody, like I’m just faking my way through the apprenticeship. Even stuff other people would probably just fix and move on from, I take it like I let my family down… and the younger apprentices too.
Do you feel like you're not good enough most of the time?

Most of the time lately, yeah. I keep thinking I’m messing everything up… like I don’t really belong in the apprenticeship, and I’m letting people down over things I know other people would probably just handle.
Do you often worry about the future?
I mean… a little, I guess. I try not to think too far ahead. It just kind of feels uncertain.
Do you find pleasure in the things you're doing nowadays?

Not really… not like I used to. I’ll walk right past my sketchbook, skip volleyball, ignore the volunteer group texts… and I don’t even feel much about it. Those used to be the things that felt like me.
Do you often feel worthless?

Yeah… I do. I keep feeling like I’ve ruined things for everybody, like I’m just faking my way through the apprenticeship. Like I let my family down, and the younger apprentices too, over things other people would probably just fix and move on from.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Um… probably around nine months. It’s been there a while, but it got harder to keep it together once school and work started slipping.
Have you had any periods in the last nine months where you felt better for at least a couple of months?

Not really, no. It’s kind of been this same stretch for about nine months… maybe a little up and down, but I don’t think I had a couple months where I actually felt better. It just got harder to hide once school and work started slipping.
Are you usually feeling this way for most of the day?
Yeah… most days, it’s there a lot. I can be doing other things, but it keeps coming back — like I messed everything up, or I’m just not really good enough to be there.
Have you ever felt this way before, like you're not good enough and messing everything up, in a period of time before these past nine months?

Not really like this before. I mean, I’ve felt unsure of myself, but this… feeling like I ruined things for everyone, like I’m some kind of fake in the apprenticeship, and that I let my family and the younger apprentices down… that’s more what’s been happening lately.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt similarly down or not good enough before these past nine months?

No… not really before this. I’ve felt bad about messing up before, but this is different. Lately it’s more like I ruined things for everybody, like I’m a fake in the apprenticeship and I let people down over stuff other people would probably just fix and move on from.
Have you ever had another period like this in your life before the past nine months?
No… I don’t think so. Not like this. This feeling that I ruined things and let everyone down — that’s what made me come in.
Have you ever had an episode like this before in your life that lasted for a while and then got better on its own?
I don’t think so. Not one that lasted like this and then just went away on its own.
Have you had more than one period like this in your life?
No… I don’t think so. Just this one, as far as I can tell.
Have you had any episodes like this before in your life that got better on their own?
No… I don’t think so. Not that I can remember, anyway.
